usage: The word 姐姐 (ze2 ze2) refers to an older sister in a family.
It is commonly used to address or talk about your elder sister directly or indirectly.
You can use 姐姐 in both formal and informal situations.
In sentences, 姐姐 usually comes after pronouns or other subjects, e.g., 我姐姐 (ngo5 ze2 ze2) means 'my older sister'.
It can also be used to show respect or familiarity when talking about someone’s older sister.
